name: read_file
description: Read the contents of any file within the Laravel project. Use this to inspect existing migrations, models, components, views, or config files before generating code.

path.description: Relative path from the Laravel project root (e.g. 'app/Models/Product.php', 'resources/views/livewire/product-table.blade.php', 'database/migrations/2024_01_01_000000_create_products_table.php')
